about: r10-3: amount + fee against ONE balance. Replayed by tests/app_send_fee_cover.rs; shells that drive the same core machines replay the same cases. On Arc (5042002) the native coin USDC (token_address null, 18 places) and its ERC-20 interface 0x3600…0000 (6 places) are one balance (manage_tokens::native_alias_token): a fee quoted in either face is drawn from the money sent in either face.

send.about: The send machine. Each case: boot with `tokens` (chain_id, address null = native, decimals, balance as a decimal string), select `token` (its index in `tokens`), type `amount`, Continue to the confirm with a zero native fee, then the fee in `fee` lands ON THE CONFIRM PAGE (Event::FeeUpdated) — the path r10-3 took. `fee.asset` native carries total_wei; erc20 carries token/decimals/amount (base units). Expected: SendView.can_confirm, SendView.same_asset_fee_issue (null, or its fee_amount/total/max_transfer_amount in the SENT token's base units) and SendView.amount_warning.type (null or the snake_case variant).

max.about: Max on the form: the fee lands (Event::FeeUpdated), then Event::TapMax. `max_units` is the exact fill (SendView.token_amount) in the token's base units; `warning` as above. r14-8: Max holds back exactly the fee of the quote in hand — an ERC-20 fee its amount, a native fee its total_wei — converted to the sent face's places, rounded up: the same ceiling SendView.same_asset_fee_issue.max_transfer_amount says, and the one the confirm's gate accepts (no 1.5× drift reserve: a Max follows every quote to the confirm instead, see `ceiling`).

ceiling.about: r14-8: ONE ceiling, from the quote the confirm draws, followed to the signature. The tester's Arc send: 0.1196 USDC held, the hint said "You can send up to 0.008792" against a 0.110808 fee while the confirm charged 0.0984, and 0.012408 stayed behind. Each case boots on `tokens`, selects `token`, types the payee, and lets `quotes[0]` land on the form (Event::FeeUpdated). `hint`: type `over` (more than fits) — SendView.same_asset_fee_issue says the ceiling against the quote in hand, and Event::TapMax fills exactly that figure. `max`: tap Max on the form, Continue with the pre-check answered by `quotes[1]`, then `quotes[2]` lands on the confirm (the fee card's once-a-block re-quote), then the confirm is slid and `quotes[3]` lands while it signs. Every quote is an ERC-20 fee on Arc's 0x3600 interface (6 places) unless it says otherwise. Expected `ceilings[i]`: the most sendable against `quotes[i]` in the token's base units — the issue's max_transfer_amount and the Max fill alike; a Max on the confirm is re-derived from each new quote (SendView.max_moved says it) until the slide, and frozen from then on.

press_freeze.about: §34 (R20 S1, iOS, Arc Testnet): charged = shown, frozen at the press. The tester's account held 0.3 USDC and had never deployed, so its first send also deployed it; Max on the confirm read 0.0675 with a 0.2325 fee, and the chain took 0.0058875 + 0.29411249999: a re-quote landed between the press and the signature, the submit returned the button without a word, and the Max was re-derived from the new quote under it. Each case boots on `tokens`, selects `token`, types the payee, lets `quotes[0]` land on the form, then either taps Max (`max`) or types `amount`, and Continues with the pre-check answered by `quotes[1]`. `moment`: `preparing` — the confirm is pressed on the review drawn, and `quotes[2]` lands while the press reads the credential and the relay's float (before the operation is built); `before_tap` — `quotes[2]` lands on the confirm and the tap carries the review it was drawn on before that. Expected `pressed`: the figures drawn while the press is out (`SendView.confirm_amount`, the fee in wei, `SendView.fee_signing_key`). `stopped`: no SubmitUserOp was issued; `SendView.fee_moved` names `fee_moved_key` and, for a Max, `max_from` → `max_to`; the page draws `after.amount` and `after.fee_wei`. `signed`: the SubmitUserOp of the NEXT press (or of this one when not stopped) — its review's transfer amount and fee amount in base units. Every quote is a native fee in wei with `deployed` false (the deployment is in the fee).

fee_machine.about: The fee machine a dApp request's sheet runs (fee_policy; its confirm gate is sign_confirm::confirm_state — FeeView.confirm_fee_ready false with a fee in hand is ConfirmBlock::FeeShort). Each case asks a quote on `chain_id` for `calls` (value in base units; `erc20_transfer` encodes transfer(to, amount) on `token`) with the fee coin `fee_token` (null = native) as the person's pick. The relay's rows are built from the machine's OWN fee figure: the row that pays holds fee + what the calls state they move of that balance (in its places, rounded up) + `delta`; a `twin` row (the other face of one balance) holds the same money in its own places. `measured`, when present, is the simulation's balance changes (Event::BalanceChangesMeasured) and replaces the stated outflow. Expected: FeeView.confirm_fee_ready.
